outcome: National trends in placenta accreta spectrum
Characteristics of women with placenta accreta spectrum
Perioperative outcomes of cesarean delivery for placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 2,727,477 women who underwent cesarean delivery in the United States from October 2015 to December 2017
finding: The study found that cesarean delivery complicated by placenta accreta spectrum was associated with increased risk of surgical morbidities, severe maternal morbidity, hemorrhage, coagulopathy, shock, urinary tract injury, and death.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery for placenta increta and percreta was associated with a higher likelihood of hysterectomy and urinary tract injury compared to cesarean delivery without placenta accreta spectrum.
gest_age: Median gestational age at cesarean delivery was 36 weeks for placenta accreta and 34 weeks for both placenta increta and percreta vs 39 weeks for non-placenta accreta spectrum cases
